# Synapse-Router v1.2.0 — Complete Technical Reference

Synapse-Router (`synapse-router`) is an open-source, MIT-licensed multi-model AI agent routing engine and JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway.

## Measured 500-Request Benchmark (`synapse-router benchmark --requests 500`)
- Routing Engine P50 Latency: `745.69 µs` (`0.7457 ms`)
- Routing Engine P95 Latency: `1031.33 µs` (`1.0313 ms`)
- Frontier-Only Baseline Cost: `$3.7402 USD`
- Synapse-Router Total Cost: `$0.3520 USD` (`90.59% saved`)
- Cascade Quality Retention: `100.00%` (`confidence >= 0.78`)
- Provider Failover Recovery Rate: `100.00%` (`13/13` HTTP 429s)
- Semantic Cache Hit Rate: `22.20%` (64-bit SimHash)

- `route_agent_step`
